title: Start Here - Diátaxis in Five Minutes
summary: Introduces the Diataxis framework's four document types (tutorials, how-to guides, reference, explanation) and a pragmatic workflow for improving documentation incrementally.
when-to-read: Read when unsure which of the four documentation types a piece of content should be, or when documentation feels disorganized and needs a structural framework. Do not read for the detailed writing principles of any one type — go to the specific tutorials, how-to-guides, reference-guides, or explanation article instead.
